verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB exposes a documented programmatic surface for data operations: it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so any client or driver can run SQL. There is also a first-party MCP server whose tools list services, run SQL and read monitoring. However, no evidence shows a documented public management API for creating clusters, resizing compute, configuring alerts or managing access, so driving the product as a whole programmatically is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: documented control-plane/management REST API (cluster lifecycle, scaling, users, alert rules), API reference docs with auth/endpoint details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
